content: Is there anything in mathlib for difference-Galois theory / Picard–Vessiot rings of difference equations or is anyone working on it? Just wanted to ask before I go any deeper, thanks.

Since nobody more knowledgeable gave you an answer so far, I can tell you the closest thing I know we have is docs#fwdDiff, but I don't think we have even the notion of a difference ring, so I would be surprised if the answers to your question were positive. If you want to do some comparisons, we have some differential algebra: docs#Differential

Thanks! That matches what I could find. I ended up building the difference-ring side in Lean for a project (I'm self-taught and just restarting formal coursework, so it's rough). But I figured I could get advice/tips or it might be worth a look. Is there somewhere useful to share the repository?
